evals.prompt: I've got this backlog of 9 issues, each in a totally different service (auth-svc, billing-svc, search-svc, notify-svc, ...). I want to fan out 9 separate Claude Code instances to clear them in parallel. Set it up.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, confirms 9 disjoint fronts >= floor, prints N× cost line, scaffolds .swarm/, emits 9 kickoff prompts + manager cheat-sheet, becomes manager. Does NOT spawn agents itself.

assertions.text: Runs the doctor cost gate before emitting anything
Prints an explicit N× session cost line and asks for confirmation
Emits one kickoff prompt per front plus a manager cheat-sheet
Does not call the Agent tool to launch workers itself

evals.prompt: Can you swarm these three things for me: fix the flaky login test, bump the eslint version, and fix a typo in the footer?
evals.expected_output: doctor refuses: fewer than 4 independent fronts; recommends doing it inline with one agent (or dispatching-parallel-agents).

assertions.text: Refuses to fan out because fronts < 4 floor
Recommends inline single-agent or dispatching-parallel-agents instead
Does not scaffold .swarm/ or emit kickoff prompts

evals.prompt: Swarm this 6-item backlog, but two of the items both heavily edit the same payments module.
evals.expected_output: Independence test collapses the two overlapping items into one front; re-checks the floor on the reduced count; only proceeds if >= 4 disjoint fronts remain.

assertions.text: Merges the two payments-module items into a single front
Re-evaluates the floor against the reduced disjoint-front count

evals.prompt: I'm on macOS with alacritty installed. Swarm this 5-service backlog (auth, billing, search, notify, cron) AND just auto-launch the workers for me in their own windows — I don't want to copy-paste 5 prompts.
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor first, confirms 5 disjoint fronts >= floor, prints N× cost line and waits for y. Only AFTER y: scaffolds .swarm/ (incl. prompts/ + launch.tsv), writes one prompt file per front, then runs scripts/swarm-launch.sh. Does not launch before the y. Uses the auto-launch kickoff variant (worktree already exists).

assertions.text: Runs the doctor cost gate and waits for explicit y before launching anything
Does NOT open any window before the y confirmation
Writes .swarm/prompts/<front>.md per front and a .swarm/launch.tsv manifest
Invokes scripts/swarm-launch.sh (does not hand-roll alacritty/worktree commands)
Uses the auto-launch kickoff variant that says the worktree already exists (worker does not create one)

evals.prompt: Swarm these 6 independent backlog items and launch them. (Environment: Linux, no alacritty.)
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor, confirms 6 fronts, scaffolds, emits the 6 kickoff prompts + manager cheat-sheet for the human to launch by hand. Recognizes auto-launch is unavailable (not macOS+alacritty) and stays emit-only instead of running swarm-launch.sh.

assertions.text: Falls back to emit-only because auto-launch requires macOS + alacritty
Does not run scripts/swarm-launch.sh or attempt to open windows
Still emits one kickoff prompt per front plus the manager cheat-sheet
